headline: At Least Two Killed in Kyiv Desnyanskyi Strike
deck: A Russian missile hit a nine-storey residence in Kyiv, Ukraine, on Tuesday night; the death toll from the Russian attack on Kyiv has risen to five, with another 36 injured.
body: At least two people were killed when a Russian missile struck a nine-storey residential building in Kyiv's Desnyanskyi district on Tuesday night, Kyiv Mayor Vitalii Klitschko said, the Kyiv Independent and the Guardian reported [E1][E3].
21 people were injured in the strike on the residential building, the Guardian and the Kyiv Independent reported [E2][E3].
The missile ignited a large-scale fire and apartments were being evacuated, Klitschko said, the Kyiv Independent and the Guardian reported [E1][E3].
The death toll from the Russian attack on Kyiv has risen to five, with another 36 people injured, Glavnoe reported [E6].
Three women, aged 35, 58 and 84, were killed, Ukrinform reported [E5].
Since this paper's 13 October file that a Shahed hit a Kyiv residential high-rise on 12 October, killing two, the new fact is a missile on a nine-storey Desnyanskyi block on Tuesday night [E4].

evidence_box.fragment: Two people also died in a strike on a high-rise apartment building in the capital on Tuesday night, according to Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko, who said apartments were on fire and being evacuated.
